messages:
mike (eng-infra): heads-up — planning eu-west-3 cluster bring-up next Tue. need to lock GPU capacity and quotas. who owns the procurement + reservation runbook?

sana (cloudops): @mike i can drive the quota approvals. do we have sizing numbers (gpus/types/expected QPS) yet? :calendar: 

mike (eng-infra): rough ask: 40x A100-80GB (or closest equivalent), burstable to 60 for soak. target 3k rps gen in the new region. planning window 72h for validation.

alex (eng-sre): big ask — we should split: reserve permanent quota for baseline (40) + ephemeral reservation for bring-up (20). provider reservation needed for the burst.

jen (finance): cost check: rough hourly cost estimate? need a ballpark before approval.

kyle (vendor-relations): i can open the provider reservation with our account rep once we have exact SKUs and dates. they need: start/end UTC, reservation name, project id, and justification.

infra-bot: linked ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-7284 (GPU capacity request for eu-west-3 bring-up)

sana (cloudops): procurement checklist (first draft):
- finalise sizing n_gpus=40, burst=20, sku=A100-80GB (fallback: A100-40GB)
- cost pre-approval from finance (jen)
- quota request ticket to cloud provider (include project id + region)
- reservation request for burst capacity (provider-side booking)
- update infra tags + billing codes on reservation
- set up capacity reservation ID in infra repo (terraform var)
- pre-provision empty nodes with taints/labels for soak tests
- smoke tests + KV cache/warmup runbook
- handoff doc + oncall rotation for first 72h

mike (eng-infra): can you paste the quota request template we used last time? makes it faster.

sana (cloudops): copy from last: ```
Subject: Quota increase and reservation request - eu-west-3
Project: redwood-prod-euw3 (proj-4921)
Requested GPU SKU: A100-80GB
Current quota: 0
Requested baseline: 40
Requested burst reservation: 20 (reservation period 2026-04-07T00:00Z to 2026-04-09T23:59Z)
Justification: New inference cluster bring-up for Redwood internal + pilot customers. Expected peak token throughput = 3k rps, temporary burst for soak and validation.
Contact: sana@redwood.com, mike@redwood.com
Billing code: FIN-CLUSTER-23
```

alex (eng-sre): validation runbook bullet points:
- confirm reservation ID in provider console
- create temp nodepools with reserved SKU and set node taints: "taint=bringup:NoSchedule"
- deploy small canary workloads (streaming gen, embeddings) to verify latency and eviction behavior
- run KV cache warmup: send prefix-heavy synthetic workloads for 2h
- monitor GPU util, MIG (if applicable), and host OOM events
- run network egress/cross-region peering checks (latency to backing services)
- rollback: drain nodes + cancel reservation (if provider window allows)

jen (finance): ballpark cost: A100-80GB ~ $30/hr on reserved contracts? for 60 GPUs * 72h estimate = approx $129,600. need final quote from @kyle before sign-off.

kyle (vendor-relations): i'll ask rep for a hold price and expedited reservation approval. also request confirmation on preemption SLA for reserved pool.

mike (eng-infra): outstanding items for tomorrow:
- sana to file quota + reservation tickets (with template) — due EOD
- kyle to confirm provider lead times and provisional cost — due EOD
- jen to provisionally approve budget or escalate — due EOD
- alex to prepare terraform var + taint/label snippets for repo PR

sana (cloudops): filing now, will link ticket here when done. tagging infra oncall for handoff once reservation confirmed. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Quota request submitted: https://cloud.provider/quotas/REQ-98321 (status: pending)

mike (eng-infra): perfect. once reservation ID is in the ticket i'll make the infra PR to wire it into the cluster bootstrap pipelines and post the smoke-test checklist here. thanks all. :rocket:
